name: Cover Letter Generator
title: Free Cover Letter Generator for Job Applications
description: Write a clear cover letter in minutes. You add your own message and the tool builds the opening, closing and layout. Print or save as PDF. Free.
lead: Add the job details and your own points to get a clean one-page cover letter.
intro: A cover letter says why you are right for this job. Employers read many that sound the same, so the middle of yours should be in your own words.

This tool sets out the layout and writes a short, polite opening and closing. You write what you did and why you want the role. It uses 'Yours sincerely' when you address a named person and 'Yours faithfully' when you do not. Everything stays in your browser.
how: Enter your details and the job and company.
If you can find the name of the person hiring, add it. It reads better than 'Hiring Manager'.
Write two or three short paragraphs: why this company, your most relevant experience, and a strength that matches the advert.
Check the notes under the form, then print or save as PDF.
example: Middle paragraph: 'For the past four years I have run accounts payable for a distributor with 30 suppliers. I cut late payments by moving approvals online. The role at your company needs the same skills.' Write only what is true for you.
mistakes: Copying a template word for word.
Repeating your CV instead of adding to it.
Writing to the wrong company name.
Not checking spelling of the person's name.

faq.q: Do I need a cover letter?
faq.a: Only if the advertisement asks for one, or you want to explain something your CV does not. When in doubt, send one.

faq.q: Is my letter saved or sent anywhere?
faq.a: No. It stays in your browser. Print or save it as a PDF.

faq.q: Does it write the letter for me?
faq.a: No. It formats your points and adds a standard opening and closing. The content is yours.

disclaimer: This tool formats the details you type. It does not check facts, guarantee interviews or give career advice. Read your CV and letter carefully before you send them.
